code.text: CHEM
COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and low total protein, suggesting possible bone marrow suppression or chronic disease. There is also lymphopenia, neutropenia (relative), monocytosis, and basophilia, which may indicate an underlying hematologic or infectious process. Mildly elevated INR and low ALT are noted. Cardiac and inflammatory markers (troponin, CRP, D-dimer) are within or near normal. Clinical correlation is recommended to investigate causes such as infection, hematologic disorder, or chronic illness.
